why_the_orchestrator_and_not_an_agent: the E-19 exact-path law bars an agent from running an existence check against a shared SP directory; the auditors correctly refused and handed the checks back
method: each path was named by an auditor and is checked here explicitly; no directory was scanned, because scanning for strays would itself be the banned operation and would surface files nobody alleged
